name: rubiks-cube
title: Rubik's Cube
description: A 3D Rubik's Cube that continuously rotates and scrambles itself with smooth face animations. Features a Fresnel rim glow shader and interactive orbit controls.

usage.label: Astro
usage.code:
---
import "@/components/motion-blocks/rubiks-cube-element.ts";
---

<motion-rubiks-cube
  color="#17181A"
  rim-color="#FF6900"
  rim-power="6"
  rim-intensity="1.5"
  duration="1.5"
  gap="0.015"
  radius="0.125"
  class="w-full h-[500px]"
/>

props.name: color
props.description: Base body color of each cubelet.

props.name: rim-color
props.description: Accent color applied by the Fresnel rim shader.

props.name: rim-power
props.description: Controls how tight the Fresnel rim hug is. Higher values yield a thinner outline.

props.name: rim-intensity
props.description: Intensity multiplier for the Fresnel rim color.

props.name: duration
props.description: Seconds it takes to complete a face rotation.

props.name: gap
props.description: Gap between cubelets to accentuate separation.

props.name: radius
props.description: Corner radius for softened cube edges.

props.name: offset-x
props.description: Horizontal cube offset in normalized viewport units.

props.name: offset-y
props.description: Vertical cube offset in normalized viewport units.
